draft.title: Stereotypes and complex characters
card: A stereotype reduces a whole group to a few fixed traits, as if every member were the same. The traits are often simple and one-sided.
A complex character has mixed qualities, such as kindness and stubbornness together. They have their own reasons and can change as the story goes on.
Suppose a story shows every teenager as lazy and glued to a phone. That is a stereotype. A teenager who is shy, funny, hard-working and changes after a setback is complex.
Complex characters usually make a fairer representation, because they show people as individuals and not as a single type. Readers can ask: is this character only one trait, or a whole person?
draft.remember: A stereotype is a fixed, simple type. A complex character is mixed and can change.

a.q: Which description of a character is most likely to be a stereotype?
opts: A farmer who is only ever grumpy and old-fashioned
A farmer who is generous but sometimes too proud
A farmer who doubts her plans and then changes them
A farmer who fears drought yet enjoys the hard work
a.why: The first farmer is reduced to two fixed traits, and nothing shows reasons or change. The others mix qualities or show change, so they are more complex.
a.clue: Look for the character who is only one or two fixed traits.

b.q: A novel shows every city teenager as selfish. One chapter follows Dan, who is selfish at first, then helps a neighbour and begins to see things differently. What does Dan's chapter do to the novel's representation?
opts: It makes one character complex, so the view is less fixed
It shows that the novel has no stereotypes at all
It turns Dan into a stereotype of kind teenagers
It makes the representation fairer for every teenager
b.why: Dan has mixed qualities and changes, so he is complex, and that works against a fixed view. It does not remove the stereotype from the rest of the novel, and one character cannot make the whole representation fair.
b.clue: Dan changes, but the other teenagers in the novel do not.

a.best: A farmer who is only ever grumpy and old-fashioned

b.best: It makes one character complex, so the view is less fixed
